Use case: identity-preserve composition refinement. Recompose this ONE complete illustration coherently, no patchwork, no pasted figures or objects. Output 4:5 portrait, preferably 1122 x 1402 or equivalent. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the approved first Tidus blitzball painting. Preserve exactly its recognizable sunblond-haired, blue-eyed youthful FFX Tidus identity, confident delighted competitive expression, yellow short jacket with white hood, black asymmetric sport shorts and suspenders, gold boots, necklace, glove/armor design, luminous underwater Luca-stadium scene and the same Kalistar painted material treatment. This is ordinary nonsexual athletic sports action. Images 2 Momo and 3 Valazar are mandatory STYLE references only: sculptural visible brushwork, painted color planes, worn fabric/metal, expressive natural face, never anime, photo or smooth 3D. Do not copy their characters or dark mood.

The ONLY objective is to fix the composition for a card whose two stat rails HIDE the outer 17% on each side. Current target image has left hand near x8%, right hand near x83% and large ball near x86%, which will be hidden. Rebuild the SAME dynamic twisting soccer-style underwater volley in a COMPACT centered silhouette. Preserve movement, not the overly spread arms. Face near x48%, y23%; torso near x46%, y40%. Both elbows bend naturally closer to the torso for balance. Leftmost visible fingertips at x24-28%, never less than x20%; rightmost hand around x69-72%, never over x77%. Keep each arm anatomically continuous, no shoulder dislocation.

Bring the SINGLE patterned blitzball wholly inward, its center at x70%, y61%, diameter approximately 14% of the entire canvas width: left edge x63%, right edge x77%. ALL of the ball and its clear blue/white/gold pattern must be visible. One forward gold boot strikes toward the ball from x54-62%, y61%, small believable contact gap and motivated bubble burst; NO overlap hiding the ball. One back leg bends naturally down-left, entire boot within x22-36%, y75%. Exactly TWO connected arms, exactly TWO connected legs, no extra shoes or hands, only ONE ball. Whole head/feet safely inside with ample framing margin. Large readable figure occupying about 76-82% of height, NOT miniature. Both hands, both feet and entire ball fit within the central x20-80% zone. The ball must NOT drift to the outer right edge again. A more front-facing compact volley pose is preferable to stretching the figure across the full canvas. Preserve coherent center of gravity, dynamic twist and joyous intense expression.

Keep the same underwater volumetric cyan/turquoise light, bubbles, surface sun rays and distant refracted Luca stands through water, not an underwater ruined city. Background less contrasted than face/gesture. No waterline across body, no floating disembodied accessories, no second ball. NO sword, no dagger, no staff, no other weapon. NO text, logo, frame, watermark, numbers, UI, border, collage or smooth anime facial treatment. This is a fresh coherent recomposition from the image, not a pixel patch or plain crop.
